title: Question deferred for later
description: "Let's check after the meeting" turns a question into follow-up work. High-priority gap.
objective: Decide whether to build on Microsoft Teams first.

lines.text: If we build on Teams first we need meeting data.
Can Teams actually give an external product access to live transcript data?
I assume so. We'd need to check.
Let's check after the meeting then.
Fine. What about the onboarding flow?
Onboarding should take under five minutes.
